lines.text: Many learners say: I go to school by foot.
Better: I go to school on foot.
On foot! We go home on foot.

data.wrong: I go to school by foot.
data.right: I go to school on foot.

native.tip: 한국어 “걸어서”는 ‘버스로, 지하철로’의 ‘~로’와 비슷하게 느껴져서 by foot으로 옮기기 쉬워요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I go to school on foot.”

en.tip: Use on foot, not by foot. Say “I go to school on foot.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I go to school by foot.” Use on foot, not by foot. Right: “I go to school on foot.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
